title: Predicator sibling conformance ratchet registry
description: The registry format a sibling implementation (impl/rb, impl/ts, or any future port) uses to record which corpus cases it passes, on which surface, against which corpus version. This repo does not ship a registry; conformance/examples/registry.example.json is a hand-maintained worked example, kept correct against this checkout's own corpus by test/predicator/conformance/ratchet_registry_test.exs, and conformance/RATCHET.md is the normative contract - the two surfaces' case sets, the verify-then-add growth rule, and the ordering and encoding rules this schema cannot express.

claims.description: Zero or more {surface, tier} objects, at most one per surface - 'every case in tiers 1..N on this surface has an entry' (conformance/RATCHET.md rule R5). May be empty. See RATCHET.md for the required sort order (by surface, ascending by codepoint), which this schema cannot express.

corpus_hash.description: The conformance/manifest.json corpus_hash every entry was verified against - the pin (conformance/RATCHET.md).

entries.description: One {case_id, surface, tier} per verified pass - the ratchet itself. See conformance/RATCHET.md for the required sort order (surface, then tier, then case_id, all ascending by codepoint) and the one-element-per-line encoding, neither of which this schema can express.

case_id.description: A corpus case id (conformance/schema/corpus.json's id pattern). Stable forever once shipped.

implementation.description: Self-identifying name, e.g. "predicator-rb". Diagnostic only - not matched against anything.

isa_version.description: The manifest's isa_version at pin time. Redundant with corpus_hash by design - see conformance/RATCHET.md.
